📖 How to use

  1. Enter a value and pick the source unit.
  2. Pick the target unit — the result updates live.
  3. Adjust root/parent font size for accurate relative conversions.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the conversion work?

Every unit is converted through an absolute pixel value first: absolute units use fixed ratios (1in = 96px), relative units use your root/parent font size or the live viewport dimensions.

Where do vw and vh values come from?

vw/vh/vmin/vmax are read live from window.innerWidth/innerHeight, so they reflect your actual browser window.

How accurate are ex and ch?

ex and ch depend on the font in use; the tool uses the common approximations ex ≈ 0.5em and ch ≈ 0.5em and labels them as such.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
